queries.result: Official Chinese results identified the Xinmi Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, its Natural Resources Registration Office, and a government notice describing registration-information and cadastral-map visual inquiry via the Zhengzhou real-estate-registration information system; no anonymous public parcel ID plus geometry API was exposed.

registryEvidence: The official Xinmi Natural Resources and Planning Bureau page assigns its Natural Resources Registration Office responsibility for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral surveys, real-estate surveying, dispute handling, results application, and maintaining the registration information platform. The official Xinmi notice also identifies the Zhengzhou real-estate-registration information system as the basis for cadastral-map visual inquiry.
